cases.task: Repair engine.js only. Implement a finite non-wrapping Conway's Game of Life engine. createGrid(width,height,alive) must validate positive integer dimensions and seed in-bounds coordinates. nextGeneration(grid) must return a new grid without mutation. toggleCell(grid,x,y) must return a new grid with one valid cell toggled and reject out-of-bounds coordinates. randomGrid(width,height,probability,rng) must validate probability 0..1 and use the supplied rng function once per cell. Do not change index.html, package.json or engine.test.js.
